title: Professional Oil Painting Trial Art Class | Art Course | Art Lesson (Suitable for beginners I All art materials provided)
description: Wine, brushes, and zero judgment. A casual guided painting session where the vibe matters more than the art. Great for solo evenings or small groups.

host.name: Visual Arts Centre Singapore
host.bio: Canvas & Co. was founded by two art school graduates who wanted to make painting social rather than precious. They've hosted over 1,000 sessions and have a strict no-judgment policy that they take very seriously.

whatToExpect:
You'll arrive to find your canvas set up with a light pencil sketch guide and your first glass of wine poured. The session is guided — a Canvas & Co. artist walks through the painting step by step — but the pace is loose and the music is good.

The subject changes each session: landscapes, botanicals, abstract colour fields. You won't know the exact painting until you arrive, which keeps regulars coming back.

Everyone leaves with a finished (or at least complete) piece. Canvas & Co. provides all materials — brushes, acrylics, canvas, aprons. Just bring yourself and a willingness to ruin a shirt.
